test_objective: Confirm the pilot is authorized and bounded
precondition: Written pilot charter names systems, dates, technicians, customers, and prohibited actions
procedure: Review the charter with technical and business owners before installing an agent
expected_result: Every device, tenant, user, action, and decision owner is explicitly in or out of scope
evidence_required: Approved charter and scope list
stop_condition: Any target lacks documented authorization

test_objective: Define measurable go and no-go criteria
precondition: Pilot objectives and baseline are available
procedure: Record pass criteria, failure thresholds, required evidence, and the final decision rule
expected_result: Each tested capability has an observable pass condition and an accountable approver
evidence_required: Signed acceptance criteria
stop_condition: The team cannot agree what evidence would justify rollout

test_objective: Select a small representative endpoint set
precondition: Supported operating-system and business-criticality data are known
procedure: Choose current and older supported workstations plus a server only when server management is in scope
expected_result: Pilot devices represent intended use without creating uncontrolled production risk
evidence_required: Pilot inventory with owner and criticality
stop_condition: A production-critical system is included without an approved recovery path

test_objective: Prepare independent recovery and removal paths
precondition: Local or out-of-band access and current recovery information are available
procedure: Document uninstall, service recovery, credential revocation, network isolation, and restore steps
expected_result: The team can stop the pilot without relying only on the product under test
evidence_required: Tested rollback record and recovery contacts
stop_condition: No independent way exists to regain control of a pilot endpoint

test_objective: Verify unique identities and MFA
precondition: Named pilot technicians exist
procedure: Sign in with each role; test MFA; disable one technician; attempt reuse of the disabled session
expected_result: Every technician is attributable and disabled access stops working promptly
evidence_required: Identity list, MFA evidence, revocation timestamp, and session result
stop_condition: Shared admin credentials or reusable disabled sessions are required

test_objective: Verify least-privilege role boundaries
precondition: Pilot roles and permitted actions are documented
procedure: Attempt allowed and disallowed actions with technician, read-only, and administrator roles
expected_result: Each role can perform only its approved work and denied actions remain denied across UI and API paths
evidence_required: Role matrix and authorization test results
stop_condition: A low-privilege role can perform an unapproved privileged action

test_objective: Test enrollment identity and installer handling
precondition: A clean pilot endpoint and approved installer are available
procedure: Install once; inspect enrollment behavior; revoke the device; attempt duplicate or unauthorized enrollment
expected_result: The enrolled device has a distinct identity and revoked enrollment cannot be reused
evidence_required: Installer source, device identifier, revocation result, and duplicate-enrollment result
stop_condition: A shared secret permits uncontrolled enrollment

test_objective: Verify deterministic tenant, site, and policy assignment
precondition: Expected customer, site, and policy are documented
procedure: Enroll devices through each supported path and compare actual placement with the approved map
expected_result: Every endpoint lands in the correct tenant, site, group, and policy without manual ambiguity
evidence_required: Expected-versus-actual placement report
stop_condition: Any endpoint appears in the wrong customer boundary

test_objective: Test inventory accuracy and duplicate handling
precondition: Known hardware and software baseline is available
procedure: Compare reported identity, OS, hardware, software, owner, and last-seen data; reinstall or rename one endpoint
expected_result: Inventory differences are explainable and reinstall or rename events do not create silent duplicates
evidence_required: Baseline comparison and duplicate-resolution record
stop_condition: The same endpoint can be managed as two active identities without a visible warning

test_objective: Verify signal-to-ticket routing and ownership
precondition: One safe test condition and service-desk route are approved
procedure: Trigger the condition; observe collection, threshold, alert, notification, ticket, assignment, acknowledgement, recovery, and closure
expected_result: The event reaches the correct queue with timestamps, context, owner, and recovery state
evidence_required: Event timeline, alert, ticket, and closure evidence
stop_condition: A critical condition is lost, crosses tenants, or has no accountable owner

test_objective: Test suppression, deduplication, and maintenance windows
precondition: A repeatable noncritical signal is available
procedure: Generate repeated signals during normal and approved maintenance periods
expected_result: Duplicate events are grouped or suppressed predictably without hiding the first occurrence or final recovery
evidence_required: Alert counts and maintenance-window comparison
stop_condition: Suppression hides a distinct critical event or persists beyond the approved window

test_objective: Compare patch inventory with the endpoint
precondition: Current OS update state is independently known
procedure: Run assessment; compare missing, installed, pending-reboot, superseded, failed, and excluded updates
expected_result: Reported patch state matches the endpoint or every difference has a documented explanation
evidence_required: Endpoint screenshots or commands and platform export
stop_condition: The platform reports compliant while a required update is observably missing

test_objective: Test approval, scheduling, restart, and evidence
precondition: A noncritical update and maintenance window are approved
procedure: Approve only the selected update; deploy in the window; observe download, install, restart handling, final state, and ticket evidence
expected_result: Only approved targets and updates run; restart behavior follows policy; final status is explainable
evidence_required: Approval, target list, timestamps, install result, restart result, and final assessment
stop_condition: An unapproved device, update, or restart is triggered

test_objective: Test a safe patch failure and remediation path
precondition: A reversible lab condition can produce a controlled failure
procedure: Create the condition; run assessment or deployment; remove the condition; retry according to policy
expected_result: Failure is distinct from delay or offline state; retry is bounded; original evidence remains available
evidence_required: Failure code, alert, ticket, remediation, retry, and final state
stop_condition: The system loops indefinitely or overwrites the original failure evidence

test_objective: Verify script targeting and approval controls
precondition: A harmless script and approved pilot group exist
procedure: Preview targets; require approval; remove one device; execute; compare intended and actual targets
expected_result: Only the approved current target set runs and the audit record identifies content, approver, operator, and result
evidence_required: Script hash or version, target preview, approval, execution log, and endpoint result
stop_condition: A device outside the approved scope executes the script

test_objective: Test bounded execution and interruption behavior
precondition: A harmless long-running test task is approved
procedure: Run the task; allow timeout on one endpoint; cancel another; inspect retries and partial output
expected_result: Timeout, cancellation, failure, and success are distinct; retries are bounded; partial output is preserved
evidence_required: Execution timeline, cancellation result, retry count, and output
stop_condition: Cancellation does not stop future or queued work

test_objective: Verify remote-session controls
precondition: Pilot user, technician, consent rule, and session window are approved
procedure: Start, use, and end a session; test consent behavior; transfer or elevate only if in scope; inspect audit evidence
expected_result: Session access follows the approved consent and role rules and produces attributable start, end, actor, and target evidence
evidence_required: Consent evidence, session timestamps, technician identity, target, and audit record
stop_condition: A denied or unapproved technician can establish a session

test_objective: Verify revocation stops remote control
precondition: An active pilot session and independent endpoint access exist
procedure: Disable the technician or revoke the device during the session; attempt reconnect and queued work
expected_result: Active or subsequent access ends according to documented policy and revoked identities cannot reconnect
evidence_required: Revocation timestamp, session end, reconnect result, and queued-work result
stop_condition: Revoked access remains usable beyond the accepted limit

test_objective: Test cross-tenant object access
precondition: Two authorized test tenants with nonproduction objects exist
procedure: Using search, direct links, reports, exports, API calls, and bulk actions, attempt to access the other tenant from a restricted role
expected_result: No object, metadata, action, search result, report, or export crosses the tenant boundary
evidence_required: Negative-test record for each access path
stop_condition: Any customer object or action is exposed across tenants

test_objective: Verify logs can reconstruct privileged work
precondition: Known test actions and synchronized time references exist
procedure: Perform login, policy change, script run, patch action, remote session, export, and deletion or removal test
expected_result: Logs identify actor, target, action, timestamp, outcome, and relevant change detail with consistent time zones
evidence_required: Exported audit sample and action crosswalk
stop_condition: A privileged action cannot be attributed or reconstructed

test_objective: Test evidence portability
precondition: Required retention and export formats are documented
procedure: Export inventory, alerts, audit events, patch results, and reports; compare fields and timestamps with the UI
expected_result: Required evidence is usable outside the platform and retention behavior matches the documented policy
evidence_required: Export files, field comparison, retention setting, and retrieval result
stop_condition: Required evidence is inaccessible without an undocumented dependency

test_objective: Verify offline and stale-state handling
precondition: A pilot device can be disconnected safely
procedure: Disconnect the endpoint; queue allowed work; observe status and alerts; reconnect; inspect ordering and expiry
expected_result: Offline state is explicit; stale data is distinguishable; queued work obeys documented expiry and ordering
evidence_required: Disconnect and reconnect timestamps, status, queue, and final result
stop_condition: Silence is reported as healthy or expired work executes unexpectedly

test_objective: Verify agent or service recovery without hiding failure
precondition: A reversible lab interruption is approved
procedure: Stop the agent service or block communication; observe detection; restore service; compare missed and recovered data
expected_result: Interruption is visible, recovery is bounded, and evidence distinguishes the gap from normal operation
evidence_required: Failure alert, local state, recovery timestamp, and reconciled history
stop_condition: The platform silently fills or erases the evidence gap

test_objective: Verify complete removal and identity revocation
precondition: Removal procedure and independent endpoint access are available
procedure: Uninstall the agent and helpers; remove the device record according to policy; inspect services, files, tasks, drivers, certificates, credentials, and queued work
expected_result: Documented components are removed or retained for a stated reason; remote and queued work no longer succeeds
evidence_required: Removal checklist, residual-component results, revocation evidence, and reconnect test
stop_condition: Remote control or automation remains possible after accepted removal

test_objective: Make the rollout decision from evidence
precondition: All mandatory tests have a result, evidence link, owner, and unresolved-risk record
procedure: Review failures, exceptions, technician effort, support dependencies, security findings, and remediation commitments with approvers
expected_result: Decision is go, limited go, remediate and retest, or no-go; scope and residual risk are explicit
evidence_required: Signed decision record, exception register, remediation plan, and next review date
stop_condition: A mandatory stop condition is waived without named authority and recorded rationale
